select pst.bbs_id , pst.pst_id , pst.ttl , pst.bbs_st_ymd || pst.bbs_st_tm as rgt_dt ,(case when sts.mbr_id is null then 'N' else 'Y' end) as is_read ,(case when sts.view_use_yn = 'N' then 'N' else 'Y' end) as is_view ,(case when sts.view_use_yn = 'N' then 'N' else 'Y' end) as view_use_yn from cdm_own.cmpt_bbs_pst pst inner join cdm_own.cmpt_bbs bbs on bbs.bbs_id = pst.bbs_id left outer join cdm_own.cmpt_bbs_read_sts sts on sts.bbs_id = pst.bbs_id and sts.pst_id = pst.pst_id and sts.mbr_id = #{mbrId} where bbs.use_yn = 'Y'
and pst.bbs_ed_ymd || pst.bbs_ed_tm >= to_char(now() - interval '60 days', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') and bbs.bbs_id = 'NOTICE' and TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') between coalesce(pst.bbs_st_ymd,'19000101') || coalesce(bbs_st_tm, '000000') and coalesce(pst.bbs_ed_ymd,'21991231') || coalesce(bbs_ed_tm, '000000') and pst.view_use_yn = 'Y' and pst.use_yn = 'Y'
and sts.mbr_id is null
and (sts.view_use_yn = 'Y' or sts.view_use_yn is null)
order by pst.bbs_st_ymd || pst.bbs_st_tm desc
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cdm_own.cmpt_bbs_read_sts (bbs_id, pst_id, mbr_id, first_read_dt, last_read_dt, read_cnt, view_use_yn) VALUES (#{bbsId}, #{pstId}, #{mbrId}, NOW(), NOW(), 1, 'Y') ON CONFLICT (bbs_id, pst_id, mbr_id) DO UPDATE SET last_read_dt = NOW(), read_cnt = cmpt_bbs_read_sts.read_cnt + 1
mapper.select:
select cmpy_id ,srvc_qstn_id ,srvc_qstn_cn ,srvc_ans_cn ,TO_CHAR(srvc_ans_dt, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') as srvc_ans_rgt_dt ,(case when csq.rgtr_ans_read_dt is null then 'N' else 'Y' end) as is_read ,(case when csq.view_use_yn = 'N' then 'N' else 'Y' end) as is_view ,(case when csq.view_use_yn = 'N' then 'N' else 'Y' end) as view_use_yn from cdm_own.cmpt_srvc_qstn csq where csq.cmpy_id = #{cmpyId} and csq.rgtr_id = #{mbrId}
and csq.srvc_ans_dt is not null and csq.srvc_qstn_rcpt_yn = 'Y'
and csq.srvc_ans_dt >= (now() - interval '60 days')
and csq.rgtr_ans_read_dt is null
and (csq.view_use_yn = 'Y' or csq.view_use_yn is null)
order by csq.srvc_ans_dt desc

select sndng.ums_id ,sndng.ums_ttl ,sndng.ums_cn ,sndng.send_ymd || sndng.send_tm as send_dt ,rcvr.send_rslt_cd ,rcvr.ums_sn ,rcvr.cmpy_id ,(case when rcvr.send_rslt_cd = '0000' then 'N' else 'Y' end) as is_read ,(case when rcvr.send_rslt_cd = '9998' then 'N' else 'Y' end) as is_view ,(case when rcvr.send_rslt_cd = '9998' then 'N' else 'Y' end) as view_use_yn from cdm_own.cmpt_ums_sedng_info sndng inner join cdm_own.cmpt_ums_rcvr rcvr on sndng.ums_id = rcvr.ums_id where rcvr.mbr_id = #{mbrId}
and sndng.send_ymd || sndng.send_tm >= to_char(now() - interval '60 days', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
and rcvr.send_rslt_cd = '0000'
and rcvr.send_rslt_cd != '9998'
